usedFor: Shopify raises store events such as “Order Cancelled”, and OneDrive receives a folder through “Create Folder”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Folder” in OneDrive
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets its own folder, ready for related files.

watchOut: Choose where “Create Folder” in OneDrive places the folder: the root, a parent folder or a shared folder.
